server_id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this server in a replication setup.

basedir.description: Base directory where MariaDB binaries and libraries are installed.

datadir.description: Directory where database files (tables, logs, etc.) are stored.

socket.description: Unix socket file path for local connections.

port.description: TCP port number for remote connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of one packet or any row (e.g., '64M').

default_storage_engine.description: Default storage engine for newly created tables (e.g., 'InnoDB', 'Aria').

wait_timeout.description: Number of seconds the server waits for activity on an idle connection.

interactive_timeout.description: Number of seconds the server waits for activity on an interactive connection.

lock_wait_timeout.description: Number of seconds to wait for a metadata lock before giving up.

character_set_server.description: Default character set for new databases and tables.

collation_server.description: Default collation for new databases and tables.

enable_binlog.description: Enable binary logging (required for replication and point-in-time recovery).

binlog_path.description: Base name/path for binary log files.

binlog_format.description: Binary logging format (ROW, STATEMENT, or MIXED).

enable_general_log.description: Enable general query log (not recommended for production due to performance impact).

general_log_file.description: Path to the general query log file.

enable_slow_log.description: Enable logging of slow queries (queries exceeding long_query_time).

slow_query_log_file.description: Path to the slow query log file.

long_query_time.description: Threshold in seconds for logging slow queries.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of InnoDB buffer pool (e.g., '256M', '1G'). Should be ~70–80% of available RAM on dedicated servers.

innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB redo log file (affects recovery time and write throughput).

innodb_flush_method.description: How InnoDB flushes data and logs to disk (e.g., 'fsync', 'O_DIRECT').

innodb_read_io_threads.description: Number of background I/O threads for InnoDB reads.

innodb_write_io_threads.description: Number of background I/O threads for InnoDB writes.

innodb_buffer_pool_instances.description: Number of buffer pool instances (use >1 for large buffer pools, e.g., >1GB).

innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit.description: Controls durability/safety (1 = safest, 2 = faster, 0 = fastest but risky).

thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads to keep in cache for reuse.

table_open_cache.description: Number of table descriptors to cache.

open_files_limit.description: Maximum number of open files for the server.

tmp_table_size.description: Maximum size of internal in-memory temporary tables (e.g., '64M').

max_heap_table_size.description: Maximum size of user-created in-memory temporary tables.

enable_query_cache.description: Enable query cache (deprecated in MariaDB 10.1+; disable unless needed for legacy apps).

query_cache_size.description: Size of query cache memory (ignored if query cache is disabled).

query_cache_limit.description: Maximum size of individual query results that may be cached.

log_error_file.description: Path to the error log file.

skip_name_resolve.description: Skip hostname lookups for incoming connections (use IP only for security/performance).

enable_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for encrypted client connections.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to SSL server private key.

is_master.description: If true, configure this server as a replication master (binary logs enabled automatically).

replicate_do_db.description: List of database names to replicate (master only).

items.description: Database name to include in replication.

replicate_ignore_db.description: List of database names to exclude from replication (master only).

items.description: Database name to exclude from replication.

is_slave.description: If true, configure this server as a replication slave.

relay_log_path.description: Base name/path for relay log files (slave).

relay_log_index_path.description: Path to relay log index file.

gtid_mode.description: Enable GTID-based replication (requires consistent server IDs and binlog).

gtid_slave_pos.description: GTID position to start replication from (empty = auto from master).

master_host.description: Hostname or IP of the replication master.

master_password.description: Password for the replication user (store securely via secrets manager in production).

local_infile.description: Allow LOCAL INFILE (security-sensitive — disable unless needed).

use_syslog.description: Log messages to system syslog instead of log files.
